title: Traditional Irish Oatmeal
description: A warm and comforting breakfast made with steel-cut oats, perfect for a chilly morning.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring the water to a boil.
Add the steel-cut oats and reduce heat to low. Simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the oats have absorbed most of the liquid and have a creamy consistency.
Remove from heat and stir in the salt, brown sugar, and unsalted butter until the butter has melted.
Serve the oatmeal warm, topped with additional brown sugar or butter if desired.
